reason: The only available combination pairs the basket with the potato trough, which seems like the natural way to lift the crop.
expectation: I expect to harvest the potatoes into the basket, though I don't yet know what the crop will look like.

effect: The harvest produced potatoes and revealed the goal of tasting them, so the galley is the next step.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the crop that survived the storm finally harvested.
reason: The galley is the only available combination and has the equipment ready to prepare the potatoes.
expectation: I expect to wash and cook the potatoes for a meal, though the exact preparation is uncertain.

effect: Roasting the potatoes completed the harvest and tasting goals, bringing the crop's long growth to a meal.
reaction: The quiet radio hiss gives the meal a lonely but satisfying atmosphere.

mostWorthwhile.text: Lifting the potatoes was most worthwhile: seeing the larger crop made the plants' survival through the storm feel tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: The galley action was straightforward and offered no decision beyond the only available combination, though the resulting meal gave it some atmosphere.

surprise.text: The potatoes were larger than the seed pieces brought from Earth, making the result of the long growing period visible.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: the basket suited harvesting and the galley suited preparing the crop.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see what happens with the body in the ice and the journey home, although this chapter itself offered only straightforward actions.
